start:
Hi ${name}! I'm ChocBot, your cacao world assistant.

I can help you with:
- Cacao prices
- Your adopted trees
- Product traceability
- Environmental and social impact

Type /help to see all commands.
help:
Available commands:

/precio - Current cacao price
/arboles - Your adopted trees
/trazabilidad - Supply chain
/impacto - Your environmental impact
/adoptar - Adopt a tree
/comunidad - Community stats
/help - This help
precio_result:
Fine Aroma Cacao Price:

- Market: $${market_price} USD/ton
- Chocosfera fair price: $${fair_price} USD/ton (+22%)
- Farmers receive: $${farmer_price} USD/ton

Last update: ${time}
arboles_none: You haven't adopted any trees yet. Visit ${url}/en/dashboard/trees to adopt your first cacao tree.
arboles_header:
Your adopted trees:

Total: ${count} trees
Production: ${production} kg
CO2 offset: ${co2} ton
trazabilidad:
Cacao Traceability at Chocosfera:

1. Planting - Tree planted and registered on blockchain
2. Growth - Certified organic monitoring
3. Harvest - Blockchain verified
4. Processing - Fermentation and drying
5. Distribution - Direct fair trade

Certifications: Fair Trade, Organic, Carbon Neutral, Rainforest Alliance

Learn more: ${url}/en/dashboard/traceability
adoptar:
Adopt a cacao tree and contribute to fair trade.

Each tree:
- Captures ~24 kg CO2/year
- Generates income for local farmers
- Produces fine aroma cacao

Adopt here: ${url}/en/dashboard/trees
